Core Modules

The Spec-Coder Agent is composed of several core modules that work together to provide the complete functionality.

OpenSpec-to-Code Generator

asabaal_utils.agents.spec_coder.orchestrator

🧩 Full Integration Orchestration Layer

This script unifies the entire software development pipeline from OpenSpec specifications through code generation, testing, and optional healing.

Usage:

python scripts/run_integration.py –mode fresh python scripts/run_integration.py –mode heal python scripts/run_integration.py –mode test

asabaal_utils.agents.spec_coder.compare_behaviors

LLM-based Behavior Comparison Analyzer

Uses AI to perform deep semantic analysis of test-spec alignment, identifying gaps, overlaps, and mismatches between test behaviors and OpenSpec requirements.

asabaal_utils.agents.spec_coder.templates

Prompt Templates

Contains templates for generating different types of content from OpenSpec specifications.

class asabaal_utils.agents.spec_coder.templates.PromptTemplates(source_code_prompt='Generate Python scaffolding code using the EXACT function interfaces provided.\\n\\nFor specification {spec_id}, create a file with:\\n- Module docstring: "{title}\\\\nVersion {version}"\\n- Import appropriate modules based on function requirements\\n- Function stubs with TODO comments and pass statements\\n- Use the EXACT function signatures provided below\\n- Single-line docstrings format: """TODO {spec_id}: description."""\\n\\nFUNCTION INTERFACES (USE EXACTLY AS SPECIFIED):\\n{interfaces}\\n\\nREQUIREMENTS:\\n{requirements}\\n\\nIMPORTANT: Use the exact function names, parameter names, and types from the interfaces above.\\nDo not infer or modify the signatures - use them exactly as provided.', test_prompt='\\nGenerate comprehensive pytest tests for the following requirement:\\n\\nRequirement ID: {req_id}\\nTitle: {req_title}\\nDescription: {req_description}\\nValidation: {validation}\\n\\nGenerate tests that verify:\\n- Correct functionality\\n- Edge cases\\n- Error conditions\\n- Type safety\\n\\nReturn only the test code without explanations.\\n', documentation_prompt='\\nGenerate markdown documentation for the following specification:\\n\\nSpecification ID: {spec_id}\\nTitle: {title}\\nRequirements: {requirements}\\n\\nInclude:\\n- Project overview\\n- Installation instructions\\n- Usage examples\\n- API documentation\\n- Requirements traceability\\n\\nReturn only the markdown documentation without explanations.\\n', system_prompt='\\nYou are generating Python scaffolding code that matches reference implementations exactly.\\nCreate function stubs with TODO comments and pass statements.\\nDo NOT implement actual functionality - only create the structure.\\nMatch the reference format precisely.\\n')[source]

Bases: object

Container for prompt templates used in code generation.
